t.I valori si salvano in questo browser pe: Values are saved in this browser for each tool. Fine‑tuning the Z‑offset: presses too hard → increase (# → #); doesn't touch or faint line → decrease (# → #).
t.Inserisci il pennarello nel tubo dell'UM: Insert the pen into the UMTS tube: the orange tip must stick out about # mm (just visible).
t.La pressione la danno insieme <b>molla +: Pressure comes from spring + pen depth + Z‑offset together.
t.Il tubo si monta solo durante la prima p: Mount the tube only during the first pause, when the toolhead is already at the compensated height.
t.Il tratto è largo: nel tratteggio usa un: The stroke is wide: for hatching use a spacing of at least # mm.
t.<b>Capovolgi la guida e il gruppo molla: Flip the guide and the upper spring assembly, then tighten the screws making sure the back of the POSCA rests on the table: it is the fixed reference that gives constant pressure and clean lines.
t.Con il modulo di taglio originale UMTS:: With the original UMTS cutting module: for now the author says to use the Stabilo profile and calibrate Z by hand.
t.Con un porta‑lama tipo Roland (corpo zig: A Roland‑style blade holder (knurled body ~# mm) needs rostkuchen's remix “Sistema di taglio per P1 X1 (Remix UMTS)”: #/# mm tube, dedicated guide and spring. Print its test ring first.
t.Nel remix il porta‑lama sta <b>più in ba: In the remix the blade holder sits lower: the # mm Z‑offset is only a starting point, measure yours with Calibration → Pressure test.
t.Lama a #° per vinile e carta adesiva, sp: #° blade for vinyl and sticker paper, sticking out just past the material thickness. Slow (#–# mm/s), # passes.
t.Gli angoli vivi escono leggermente arrot: Sharp corners come out slightly rounded (radius ≈ blade offset): normal with drag knives.
t.Montala come la Stabilo e parti da Z‑off: Mount it like the Stabilo and start from a # mm Z‑offset.
t.Trova il valore giusto con Calibrazione: Find the right value with Calibration → Pressure test (pause at every pass).
t.Penne a gel o a sfera: #–# mm/s; marker: Gel or ballpoint pens: #–# mm/s; paint markers: #–# mm/s.
t.Il foglio va sempre nello stesso punto,: The sheet always goes in the same spot, because the tip is not where the nozzle is: # mm from the right wall and # mm from the rear wall (margins published for UMTS on X1/P1).
t.Per la ripetibilità stampa una <b>dima d: For repeatability print an alignment jig with these margins: place it, line up the sheet, remove it.
t.Fissa gli angoli con nastro di carta (in: Tape the corners with masking tape (essential with POSCA and with the blade).
t.L'area utile è ≈ <b># × # mm</b> nella p: The usable area is ≈ # × # mm in the top part of an A4, as wide as the sheet: its centre falls at the centre of the A4 width.
t.Prima volta? Fai il file <b>Calibrazione: First time? Make the Calibration → Area frame file (step #) and check where the line lands on the sheet. If it is off, correct it below: the shift applies to every file.
t.Vista dall'alto del piatto P1S con l'are: Top view of the P1S plate with the UMTS profile's excluded area. Approximate: check on your sheet with the Frame.
t.Trascina qui un'immagine o <u>sceglila</: Drop an image here or <u>choose one</u> (JPG, PNG)
t.Trascina qui un file SVG o <u>sceglilo</: Drop an SVG file here or <u>choose one</u>
t.Ogni colore del tratto diventa un gruppo: Each stroke colour becomes a group (one pen). Lines are followed along their centre, as in the file.
t.Due file dallo stesso disegno: prima la: Two files from the same design: first the pen draws the subject, then you swap the module for the blade and cut the outline. Don't move the sheet in between: the position is identical.
t.Immagine del soggetto (meglio PNG con sf: Image of the subject (best a PNG with transparent background)
t.Lama: usa materiale su supporto silicona: Blade: use material on a silicone backing (adhesive vinyl, sticker paper) taped down. The blade must stick out just past the material thickness: test on an offcut.
t.Foto dell'oggetto dritto, su sfondo unif: Photo of the object upright, on a plain background, taken from a distance with zoom (less perspective). One view is enough; side and back are placed alongside at the same scale.
t.Trascina qui un file STL o 3MF (anche il: Drop an STL or 3MF file here (Bambu Studio / Orca 3MF too)
t.cornice con riferimenti e cartiglio: border with zone references and title block
t.Le misure dalla foto sono stime, ricavat: Measurements from a photo are estimates, scaled from the height you enter. From the 3D model they are the real ones.
t.Tratteggio incrociato: più è scuro, più: Cross‑hatching: the darker, the more directions. Each direction goes on its own layer, so lines don't merge in the slicer.
t.Isolinee del tono: da # livello (sagoma): Tone isolines: from # level (silhouette) to many (topographic effect). Great for logos and silhouettes.
t.Segue il centro dei tratti: per disegni: Follows the centre of strokes: for line drawings, comics, scanned sketches.
t.Righe ondulate: l’onda si allarga e si s: Wavy rows: the wave widens and narrows with the tone.
t.Un’unica spirale dal centro, modulata da: A single spiral from the centre, modulated by tone. Just one pen lift.
t.Un’unica linea continua che passa per pu: One continuous line through points spread according to tone.
t.Disegna la cornice dell’area utile, la c: Draws the usable‑area frame, the centre cross and ticks every # mm. Use it to see where the line lands on the sheet and to set the X/Y correction.
t.Quadratini e diagonali ripetuti # volte: Small squares and diagonals repeated # times with a pause before each pass: at every pause lower the pen by #–# mm (or adjust the Z‑offset for the next file).
t.Un quadrato al centro con una passata: p: A square in the centre with one pass: for the dry runs (base only, then full set without pen) suggested by the author.
t.Ogni gruppo è un cambio di penna: Orca m: Each group is a pen change: Orca puts a pause before each one. Passes repeat the group (fuller line or deeper cut).
t.pausa anche prima di ogni passata (per r: pause before every pass too (to adjust the pen, handy for calibration)
t.salta la linea di spurgo iniziale (finir: skip the initial purge line (it would end up on the sheet)
t.Profilo “modalità plotter” di UMTS: flus: UMTS “plotter mode” profile: flow #, fans off, # mm retraction (unlocks Z‑hop), normal Z‑hop, # wall, # mm layer, # mm widths, excluded area ( 0x0, 258x0, 258x55, 48x55, 48x258, 0x258 ). The wall generator is Arachne, so each stroke becomes a single centre line.
t.a vuoto, senza modulo (la testina sale a: dry, without module (the toolhead rises to the compensated height)
First create a drawing in step #.
t.Il disegno esce dall'area utile: Orca no: The drawing goes outside the usable area: Orca would not slice it. Reduce the size or the X/Y correction.
t.<b>In caso di collisione spegni subito l: If anything collides, switch the printer off at once. Never let the print finish with the module mounted: at the end the toolhead moves to the back and the filament cutter, and the module would hit them.
t.Stampante in <b>modalità solo LAN</b> e: Printer in LAN‑only mode and Orca Slicer (Bambu Studio does not apply the Z compensation).
t.Apri il 3MF in Orca e accetta di caricar: Open the 3MF in Orca and accept loading the project settings. Orca reports modified G‑code: it is the start without purge line, expected. Ignore any “floating regions” warnings: every layer is a drawing of its own.
t.In anteprima controlla le <b>icone di pa: In the preview check the pause icons on the layers listed in step # and that the drawing doesn't touch the excluded area. Don't press “Center/Arrange”: the position is already the right one for the sheet.
t.Lascia il filamento caricato (il firmwar: Leave the filament loaded (the firmware wants to “extrude”: flow is #). When sending, turn off timelapse; levelling is optional.
t.Foglio ai margini (# mm da destra, # mm: Sheet at the margins (# mm from the right, # mm from the back), corners taped. Start the print without the module.
t.<b>Prima pausa</b>: la testina è già sal: First pause: the toolhead has already risen to the compensated height. From the screen move it somewhere handy, mount the UMTS and the tool, check it doesn't touch the glass and the spring moves freely. Resume.
t.<b>Pause di cambio</b>: sfila la penna e: Change pauses: pull out the pen and insert the next one with the same protrusion. Resume.
t.<b>Pausa finale</b>: sposta la testina,: Final pause: move the toolhead, remove the UMTS, then stop the print. (If you resume, the last layer runs dry and the print ends normally.)
Stickers: leave the sheet in place. Open the “# · Cut” file and repeat the same sequence with the blade module (blade Z‑offset).
t.Prime volte: le fasi di test consigliate: First times: the test stages recommended by the author
t.<b>A vuoto, solo base</b>: avvia senza m: Dry, base only: start without module, at the first pause mount only the base, resume (ghost drawing), remove it at the final pause.
t.<b>Set completo senza penna</b>: base +: Full set without pen: base + spring + guide, watch for collisions.
t.<b>Taratura in tempo reale</b>: foglio a: Live calibration: sheet at the margins, file Calibration → Pressure test. Insert the pen barely sticking out; at every pause lower it by #–# mm and resume, until the line is clean and the pen lifts on travel moves.
t.Manca contatto: abbassa lo Z‑offset o fa: No contact: lower the Z‑offset or let the pen stick out more.
t.Troppa pressione: alza lo Z‑offset o rit: Too much pressure: raise the Z‑offset or pull the pen back.
t.Z‑hop insufficiente: tipo Normale, #–# m: Not enough Z‑hop: Normal type, #–# mm (step #).
t.Il G‑code di pausa deve essere <kbd>M400: The pause G‑code must be <kbd>M400 U1</kbd> (already in the file).
t.Il disegno tocca l'area esclusa: riduci: The drawing touches the excluded area: reduce the size or the X/Y correction.
t.Usa Orca Slicer (non Bambu Studio), stam: Use Orca Slicer (not Bambu Studio), printer in LAN‑only mode.

t.Una penna sola: il disegno segue i toni: A single pen: the drawing follows the shades of grey. With more pens the image is split into its main colours, with one group (and one pen‑change pause) per colour.
t.Carica un’immagine: Tratto ne ricava i c: Load an image: Tratto picks out its main colours.
t.Clicca un colore e mettilo uguale al pen: Click a colour and match it to the marker you have: every area of the image goes to the pen with the closest colour, white stays paper. Drawing goes from the lightest colour to the darkest.
t.Con più penne le linee vengono divise tr: With more pens the lines are split between the colours, with a pause to change pen between one colour and the next.
t.I colori delle penne li scegli al passo: You choose the pen colours in step #.
t.Tanti piccoli punti, più fitti dove l’im: Lots of small dots, denser where the image is dark (stippling). Slow to draw but very fine: best with the Stabilo.
t.Omaggio a «Schotter» di Georg Nees (#):: A tribute to Georg Nees's «Schotter» (#): the squares fall apart towards the bottom.
t.Automa cellulare elementare: ogni riga n: Elementary cellular automaton: each row grows from the one above. Nice rules: #, #, #, #, #, #, #. Odd seed: starts from one cell in the centre; even: random first row.
